type:
∀ {τ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype τ] {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ {r : Option τ → ℕ},
        3 ≤ ↑(r none) →
          (∀ (j : τ), ↑(r none) ≤ δ * ↑(r (some j))) →
            ∀ {r₁ : ℕ},
              (∀ (j : Option τ), r j ≤ r₁) →
                ∀ {q : Option τ → ℕ},
                  (∀ (j : Option τ), 0 < q j) →
                    ∀ {B : ℝ},
                      1 ≤ B →
                        Roth.Θ B q r ≤
                          2 *
                            (Finset.Icc 1 (r none + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun l ↦
                              Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l +
                                  √(Roth.lem6Φ q r (Roth.lem6M (Fintype.card τ + 1) r₁ B l) l) +
                                √δ
